title: Check this before your morning shop
script: Before leaving home, check three things: what you already have, how much you need, and your spending limit. A useful price comparison starts with a clear shopping list, before any sale sticker gets your attention. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Before leaving home, check three things: what you already have, how much you need, and your spending limit. A useful price comparison starts with a clear shopping list, before any sale sticker gets your attention.

title: Is the offer for one or for two?
script: An advertised price may require buying more than one item. Check the minimum quantity, then calculate the full amount you must spend. Compare that total with buying only the quantity your household actually needs. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: An advertised price may require buying more than one item. Check the minimum quantity, then calculate the full amount you must spend. Compare that total with buying only the quantity your household actually needs.

title: When R10 cheaper is not cheaper
script: Illustrative example: an item is R70 plus R25 delivery. Another equivalent option is R80 plus R5 delivery. Those totals are R95 and R85. The item that looks R10 more expensive costs R10 less overall. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Illustrative example: an item is R70 plus R25 delivery. Another equivalent option is R80 plus R5 delivery. Those totals are R95 and R85. The item that looks R10 more expensive costs R10 less overall.

title: The cupboard check comes first
script: Before adding a pantry item to your basket, check whether you already have it at home. Look at quantities and expiry dates. Using what you have safely can help you avoid paying for unnecessary duplicates. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Before adding a pantry item to your basket, check whether you already have it at home. Look at quantities and expiry dates. Using what you have safely can help you avoid paying for unnecessary duplicates.

title: A small bottle can have a smaller unit price
script: Illustrative example: 500 millilitres costs R20, or R40 per litre. One litre costs R45. The smaller bottle has the lower unit price in this example. Match the exact product before using the calculation. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Illustrative example: 500 millilitres costs R20, or R40 per litre. One litre costs R45. The smaller bottle has the lower unit price in this example. Match the exact product before using the calculation.

title: Do not let a countdown write your list
script: A countdown can make a purchase feel urgent. Pause and check whether the item was on your list, whether the exact product suits you, and what the final cost will be. Decide from those facts rather than the timer. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: A countdown can make a purchase feel urgent. Pause and check whether the item was on your list, whether the exact product suits you, and what the final cost will be. Decide from those facts rather than the timer.

title: Compare what arrives at your door
script: Two offers may include different quantities or accessories. Check the exact contents of each order before comparing prices. Make sure you are comparing what you will actually receive, including the delivery charge that applies to you. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Two offers may include different quantities or accessories. Check the exact contents of each order before comparing prices. Make sure you are comparing what you will actually receive, including the delivery charge that applies to you.

title: One question for every extra item
script: Before adding an extra item to a basket, ask when you will use it. If you are buying it only to reach a discount threshold, calculate the basket with and without that extra purchase. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Before adding an extra item to a basket, ask when you will use it. If you are buying it only to reach a discount threshold, calculate the basket with and without that extra purchase.

title: A bundle can cost more per item
script: Illustrative example: four identical items cost R52, or R13 each. A single item is R12. The bundle is more expensive per item in this example. Check the unit calculation even when the packaging suggests a special offer. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Illustrative example: four identical items cost R52, or R13 each. A single item is R12. The bundle is more expensive per item in this example. Check the unit calculation even when the packaging suggests a special offer.

title: The old receipt is a clue
script: An old receipt can remind you of the product and quantity you bought. Use it as a starting point for your next comparison, then check the current retailer price. An old purchase is not a current price guarantee. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: An old receipt can remind you of the product and quantity you bought. Use it as a starting point for your next comparison, then check the current retailer price. An old purchase is not a current price guarantee.

title: Check the selected pack size
script: A product page can offer several pack sizes. Before adding to your basket, check which size is selected and which price applies. Compare that exact selection, rather than a headline price for a different quantity. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: A product page can offer several pack sizes. Before adding to your basket, check which size is selected and which price applies. Compare that exact selection, rather than a headline price for a different quantity.

title: A cheaper basket needs the same list
script: Keep your shopping list consistent when comparing two baskets. Removing an item makes a basket cheaper but changes what you are buying. Match the quantities first, then compare product totals, delivery and relevant fees. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Keep your shopping list consistent when comparing two baskets. Removing an item makes a basket cheaper but changes what you are buying. Match the quantities first, then compare product totals, delivery and relevant fees.

title: The ten-percent calculation
script: Illustrative example: ten percent off R200 takes off R20, leaving R180. Compare R180 with the price of the equivalent product elsewhere, including delivery. A discount percentage alone does not tell you which final option costs less. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Illustrative example: ten percent off R200 takes off R20, leaving R180. Compare R180 with the price of the equivalent product elsewhere, including delivery. A discount percentage alone does not tell you which final option costs less.

title: Check your delivery location
script: Delivery availability and charges can depend on where you live. Confirm the price for your own area before comparing an online offer. A general delivery message may not describe the cost of your particular order. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Delivery availability and charges can depend on where you live. Confirm the price for your own area before comparing an online offer. A general delivery message may not describe the cost of your particular order.

title: Buying less can be the right choice
script: A larger pack can have a lower unit price while requiring more money today. Check your budget and how much you will use. A smaller purchase can fit your needs better even when the bulk option wins the unit calculation. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: A larger pack can have a lower unit price while requiring more money today. Check your budget and how much you will use. A smaller purchase can fit your needs better even when the bulk option wins the unit calculation.

title: Watch for a different product strength
script: Similar packages may contain products with different strengths or instructions. Compare the exact specification and usable quantity where the information supports it. Do not assume equal bottle sizes mean equal uses. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Similar packages may contain products with different strengths or instructions. Compare the exact specification and usable quantity where the information supports it. Do not assume equal bottle sizes mean equal uses.

title: The R15 delivery difference
script: Illustrative example: a R90 item with R30 delivery totals R120. An equivalent R100 item with R5 delivery totals R105. The final difference is R15. Always include delivery before deciding which offer costs less. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Illustrative example: a R90 item with R30 delivery totals R120. An equivalent R100 item with R5 delivery totals R105. The final difference is R15. Always include delivery before deciding which offer costs less.

title: Before you tap reorder
script: A repeat order can contain changed prices or unavailable items. Review the quantities, substitutions and delivery charge before confirming it. A convenient reorder still needs a current total check. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: A repeat order can contain changed prices or unavailable items. Review the quantities, substitutions and delivery charge before confirming it. A convenient reorder still needs a current total check.

title: A good price on the wrong item
script: A lower price is not useful when the item does not meet your needs. Check dimensions, compatibility or the exact model before buying. Compare suitable options first, then look at the complete purchase cost. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: A lower price is not useful when the item does not meet your needs. Check dimensions, compatibility or the exact model before buying. Compare suitable options first, then look at the complete purchase cost.

title: Check what the voucher leaves out
script: A voucher may exclude selected products, sellers or delivery charges. Read the relevant conditions and check the discount shown in your basket. Compare the actual payable total rather than the headline voucher amount. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: A voucher may exclude selected products, sellers or delivery charges. Read the relevant conditions and check the discount shown in your basket. Compare the actual payable total rather than the headline voucher amount.

title: The price-per-kilogram shortcut
script: Illustrative example: 750 grams for R45 is R60 per kilogram. One kilogram for R58 has a lower unit price. Check equivalent products, how much you need and any extra purchase conditions before choosing. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Illustrative example: 750 grams for R45 is R60 per kilogram. One kilogram for R58 has a lower unit price. Check equivalent products, how much you need and any extra purchase conditions before choosing.

title: Make a list of quantities
script: Instead of writing only a product name, add how much you need. A defined quantity makes different packs easier to compare and helps you notice when a promotion is pushing you to buy more than planned. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Instead of writing only a product name, add how much you need. A defined quantity makes different packs easier to compare and helps you notice when a promotion is pushing you to buy more than planned.

title: Travel belongs in the comparison
script: A cheaper product across town can require more travel money. Count the additional transport or parking that applies to your trip. Compare the full cost of collecting the purchase with the alternatives you can actually use. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: A cheaper product across town can require more travel money. Count the additional transport or parking that applies to your trip. Compare the full cost of collecting the purchase with the alternatives you can actually use.

title: Do you qualify for the displayed price?
script: A displayed offer may require a membership, voucher or a particular payment option. Confirm the conditions you qualify for before using that price in a comparison. The useful number is the price available to you. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: A displayed offer may require a membership, voucher or a particular payment option. Confirm the conditions you qualify for before using that price in a comparison. The useful number is the price available to you.

title: Do not add the same fee twice
script: When comparing a basket, check whether delivery is already included in the displayed total. Add only charges that are still excluded. Accurate comparisons need the complete total, with every relevant cost counted once. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: When comparing a basket, check whether delivery is already included in the displayed total. Add only charges that are still excluded. Accurate comparisons need the complete total, with every relevant cost counted once.

title: An extra item can erase the saving
script: Illustrative example: your planned basket is R250 plus R25 delivery. Adding an unnecessary R40 item unlocks free delivery but makes the total R290. Keeping the original basket would cost R275 in this example. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Illustrative example: your planned basket is R250 plus R25 delivery. Adding an unnecessary R40 item unlocks free delivery but makes the total R290. Keeping the original basket would cost R275 in this example.

title: Compare the expiry as well as the price
script: Check whether your household can use the quantity safely before its relevant date. A large discount on food you cannot use is a different decision from a discount on food already on your list. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Check whether your household can use the quantity safely before its relevant date. A large discount on food you cannot use is a different decision from a discount on food already on your list.

title: Read the final basket one more time
script: Before confirming, check the product variants, quantities, delivery and any applied discount. Remove accidental duplicates. The final basket is the purchase you are making, so compare that total rather than an earlier product-page price. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Before confirming, check the product variants, quantities, delivery and any applied discount. Remove accidental duplicates. The final basket is the purchase you are making, so compare that total rather than an earlier product-page price.

title: Give a shopping offer one clear job
script: Ask which planned purchase an offer helps you make. If it replaces something you already need, compare the exact product and final cost. If it creates a new purchase, check whether that spending fits your budget. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Ask which planned purchase an offer helps you make. If it replaces something you already need, compare the exact product and final cost. If it creates a new purchase, check whether that spending fits your budget.

title: One useful habit for the next month
script: Keep one comparison habit after this month: match the exact product, calculate a unit price, or include delivery. Choose the one that helps your next shopping decision. Use current information instead of relying on an old deal. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Keep one comparison habit after this month: match the exact product, calculate a unit price, or include delivery. Choose the one that helps your next shopping decision. Use current information instead of relying on an old deal.
